sessionHeader: SYNTHETIC SESSION. Fictional client c02 (Rohan M.), session 2026-10-26. Not a real person.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: How have the last two weeks been, Rohan?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Not great. Work has been brutal and the baby was sick for a week.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: I'm sorry. How are you sleeping?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Barely. The feed schedule fell apart when she was sick.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: And your mood?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Low. Lower than before. I keep thinking everyone would be better off without me around.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Thank you for telling me that. I want to understand it properly. When you say better off without you, do you have thoughts of ending your life?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Not really a plan. It's more that I'm a burden. I wouldn't do anything, I have my daughter.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: I'm glad you told me, and I'm glad your daughter is a reason. Have these thoughts been more frequent?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: The last week, most days.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Let's go back to the safety plan we wrote. Do you still have it?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: It's on my phone.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Can we look at it together now and update it?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Your partner is listed as support. Does she know how you've been feeling this week?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Not really. I don't want to worry her.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Would you be willing to tell her one sentence tonight, even just "this week has been hard"?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: I can try that.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: I'd also like Dr. K. to know about this week, since you're seeing psychiatry. Is that okay with you?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Yes, that's fine.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Did the follow-up with Dr. K. get booked?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Yes, it's on Thursday evening.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Good. I'd like to check in with you before then as well. Could we do a short call on Wednesday?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Yes, Wednesday evening.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: And if things feel worse before then, you have the crisis numbers in your safety plan.

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: I know.
